title: Clients
functions: A unified customer database with profiles and contact information
Storing interaction history, inquiries, and terms
Assigning personal discounts, priorities, and statuses
Integration with order, communication, and finance modules
Segmenting the customer base and analytics by groups

title: Delivery
functions: Managing logistics and shipping of finished goods
Tracking delivery statuses and notifying customers
Integration with orders, customers, and warehouses
Assigning couriers, transport companies, and routes
Analytics on lead times, delays, and logistics costs

title: History
functions: Chronology of customer interactions across all channels
Events: calls, messages, emails, visits, tasks, statuses
Integration with chats, email, orders, and CRM logic
Search and filtering by events, time, employees, customers
Action auditing and restoration of interaction context

title: Orders
functions: Creating, editing, and tracking orders
Managing fulfillment and payment statuses
Tracking order sources and associated customers
Integration with delivery, billing, and history modules
Search, filtering, and analytics for orders

title: Requests
functions: Receiving and processing incoming requests and leads
Creating commercial offers (CP)
Tracking negotiation stages and request statuses
Integration with order, customer, and history modules
Converting requests into full orders
